feature_idea: Add dark mode to our mobile app

prd.feature_idea: Add dark mode to our mobile app

personas.name: Tech-savvy users
personas.description: Users who spend significant time on their devices and are well-versed with technology, valuing features that enhance visual comfort and save battery life.

personas.name: Night-mode enthusiasts
personas.description: Users who often interact with their devices in dark or low-light environments, making dark mode a critical feature for eye comfort.

personas.name: Accessibility-focused users
personas.description: Individuals sensitive to bright screens or suffering from vision-related issues, seeking features that reduce strain on their eyes.

personas.name: Battery-conscious users
personas.description: Users looking to optimize their device's battery life, especially on OLED screens where dark mode significantly reduces energy consumption.

workflow_output.market_insights: Implementing dark mode is becoming a standard for mobile apps due to increasing demand by users, especially those who use apps extensively in dark environments or during nighttime. Many mainstream apps have adopted dark mode to cater to user comfort and growing preferences.
workflow_output.competitive_analysis: Competitors such as Instagram, Twitter, and WhatsApp have already integrated dark mode, leading to significant positive user feedback. Apps that lack this feature are often deemed outdated, potentially driving users to competitors.
workflow_output.research_summary: Dark mode is not only a growing trend but also a requirement for modern apps due to user expectations. Benefits include reduced eye strain at night, improved readability, and energy efficiency on devices with OLED screens. Competitors who have incorporated dark mode have received overwhelmingly positive usage trends and user-focused reviews, indicating its importance.

prd_outline.details: Add an option in the app settings to toggle between light and dark mode.
Enable dark mode to activate automatically based on time of day or system preferences.
Provide additional customization, such as selecting different shades or colors for dark mode.
